https://ticket.yes24.com/English/FAQ.text: yes24 ticket login | join | korea see all concert musical play exhibition classical music my ticket purchase guide faq booking payment cancel/refund pick up ticket verified member others //--> there are [ 7 ] answers for your question [ book ]. number subject 1 is it available for nonmembers to book tickets? booking ticket is only available for members, please sign up first. 2 can i use my existing yes24 id at english-based booking site? though you are existing members of yes24, if you want to use the global yes24 ticket site, you should new sign up again. please click "join" above to start up. * global yes24 ticket site is different from "global.yes24.com" and they don't share members information. to book tickets, please sign up for the global yes24 ticket site separately. 3 until when can i book tickets and how many tickets can i purchase at a time? (show on tue~sat) available till 5 pm prior to show day to book (show on sun/mon) available till 11am on sat to book. booking limit number is 10 per person at one time. each event may have different due dates and ticket available numbers, please check details carefully. 4 can i change the dates and hours for advance purchase tickets? purchased ticket is not available to change the dates. please cancel the ticket and re-book. but, only available before the purchase due and the cancellation fee may be charged. 5 ticket booking charges booking fee? every booking charges 2,000 krw as a commission. booking fee can be refunded until 23:59 on the day of the purchasing, otherwise impossible. please note that the fee for booking will be changed. ※ date of change: august 14, 2023 at 10:00 a.m. (kst) ※ from 2,000krw to 3,000krw per ticket 6 online booking is not available. what should i do? please send an e-mail to customer center(global_yesticket@yes24.com), and we will give you a guidance. additionally, please leave your name and contact information(telephone number, e-mail address) 7 the pop-up window does not open [issue] the booking (payment) window does not open or displays a "pop-up blocked" message. [how to resolve] 1. chrome 1) click the three vertical dots in the top-right corner → settings 2) go to privacy and security → site settings 3) select pop-ups and redirects 4) under the “allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects” section, click add, enter: https://ticket.yes24.com, and click add 2. microsoft edge 1) click the three horizontal dots in the top-right corner → settings 2) go to cookies and site permissions → pop-ups and redirects 3) under the “allow” section, click add, enter: https://ticket.yes24.com, and click add *tips please ensure the site you allow is https://ticket.yes24.com (with https). if a “pop-up blocked” icon appears in the address bar, you may click it and select always allow pop-ups from this site. after updating your settings, please refresh the page and try again. *still not working? pop-ups may be blocked by company security software or ad-blocking tools. please check those programs and add ticket.yes24.com to the exception list if needed. alternatively, try using incognito/private mode or a different browser. there are [ 3 ] answers for your question [ payment ]. number subject 1 what kinds of payment methods are available for booking? 1. credit card - credit card payment is available except for the china union pay card. - for the card payment on global site, 3d authentication must be required. please check whether you got 3d authentication from your card company. 2. paypal - paypal payment is available only if there are more than 180 days left from the reservation date to the show date. - but, 10 cents for paypal payment fee will be charged, and this fee is not refundable even if you cancel your booking, so please do not make any mistake in using paypal. - paypal payment is not available when you book the tickets through the customer center. 2 can i change payment method for purchased tickets? changing the payment method is not possible. if you really want to change the payment plan, cancel the ticket and re-book it. but, only available before the purchase due and the cancellation fee may be charged. there are [ 5 ] answers for your question [ cancel/refund ]. number subject 1 i want to canel the purchased ticket. what can i do? select your advance ticket at my ticket page and click the button [cancel my purchase] below. but, only available to cancel before the cancellation deadline. 2 what is "cancellation deadline"? it is available time you can cancel your advance ticket after payment. [cancellation deadline] 1. (show on tue~sat) available till 5 pm prior to show day to cancel 2. (show on sun/mon) available till 11am on sat. to cancel 3. (show on hollidays/the day after hollidays) - (show on the day after hollidays) same as above #1,#2 - not availble for cancellation on hollidays * after the due has passed, no cancellation/change/refund 3 if i cancel the ticket, do i have to pay for cancellation fee? [cancellation fee info] > cancellation fee 1. no cancellation fee is available in 7 days from purchase date. 2. 8 days from purchase date - ~ until 10 days before showday : musical, concert, classic, ballet 4,000won per 1 ticket / others 2,000 won per 1 ticket (but, 10% of paid amount) - 9 days before showday ~ 7 days before showday : 10% of paid amount - 6 days before showday ~ 3 days before showday : 20% of paid amount - 2 days before showday ~ 1 day before showday : 30% of paid amount * no.2 policy will first be applied. • booking fee can be refund until 23:59 on the day of the purchasing, otherwise impossible. • delivery charge won't be refund for ticket that delivered or returned. • each different show has different cancellation policy. please check the policy for relevant show. 4 if i cancel tickets after payment, how do i get refund? [refund] 1. credit card - cancellation of card approval is verified after four to five(4~5)days of purchase - only purchased card is available for re-approvement of cancellation and purchase fee - if your order is unpaid, approval details and purchase cancellation are available if you cancel orders after payment with card charge, it will be deducted next month - if you cancel orders after payment, it takes three to seven(3~7) days - refund date is depend on each card company's policy. please call companies for details 2. paypal - all refunds will be sent back to the payment method of your original payment. if you paid by credit of debit card, your refund will go to your card within 30 days. if you paid by paypal cash or bank transfer, your refund will go back to the paypal balance within 5 business days. - beyond 1 day of the date of the original payment, paypal's transaction exchange rate ( including a currency conversion spread ) on the date of the refund will apply. therefore, due to changes in fees and exchange rates, you may not be able to receive the full amount of the original payment. (10 cents for paypal payment fee is not refundable even if the reservation is canceled.) - if you need further information, please contact paypal. 5 can i cancel tickets partially? basically, it is available. but, partial cancellation may not be possible depending on the discount applied. for more details, please send an e-mail to customer center via global_yesticket@yes24.com. there are [ 3 ] answers for your question [ pick up ticket ]. number subject 1 what is required to pick up tickets at the venue? please present your physical valid id card (passport) and record of booking confirmation for picking up the tickets at the venue. each different show has a different policy. in this case, the policy that is announced on details information page of each show will first be applied. so please make sure to check the detail information page. 2 international shipment is available for tickets? the availability of overseas delivery varies depending on the performance. please check the detailed information page of relevant performance, and if it is available to deliver the tickets, the delivery fee will be charged differently depending on the destination country. 3 representatives can get the ticket at will call? will-call tickets can only be collected by the ticket holder. but, each show can be operated by different policy. so please check the detailed information page of the relevant show. if your yes24 account name is different from your passport name, you can have trouble to take the booking ticket at the venue. 4 can i pick up my tickets on a different day before the show? tickets cannot be picked up before the show day. please come to the venue with enough time to take your tickets at the venue on the show day. 5 is it possible to change the way i receive the ticket? in the case of performance that can choose the overseas delivery, it can be changed as will call → overseas delivery → will call. but, changing the method of receiving tickets to overseas delivery is only available until 20 business days before the performance. if you want to change the method from will call to overseas delivery, you need to pay for the delivery fee additionally, and it only can pay by card. 6 is there any guidance for entering delivery information? 1. please enter your full name by english as the recipient name for proceeding the customs clearance without any problem. 2. all delivery information must be entered by english. 3. please check again whether all of your delivery information is correct. yes24 won't be responsible for problems that occur due to the incorrect information entered. 4. information regarding the overseas shipment can be sent by your email, which is entered your yes24 account. therefore, we recommned you to keep checking your email. 7 i want to receive my package from the korean address. we don't offer a domestic delivery service if the booking has made from the global site. if you want to get it in korea, you have to purchase it on the korean site. 8 how can i track my shipment? you can check the tracking of your shipment through the followed method. global yes24 ticket → my ticket → purchase confirm/cancel page → [tracking] icon 9 which shipping company will it be delivered? the dhl shipping company will deliver all overseas shipments. 10 how can i change the delivery information? please follow the instructions below. global yes24 ticket → my ticket → purchase confirm/cancel → [change] icon. however, delivery information can be edited only during the specified modification period and the modification period can be changed without notification. therefore, please be aware of entering the shipping information. * if you have paid by paypal, modify the delivery information is impossible. 11 are there any precautions for certain countries? brazil : by the regulation of brazilian customs, the recipient cpf number must be required. please make sure to enter your cpf number next to the address. ex: ( cpf:000.000.000-00 ) russia : due to the russian customs enforcement regulations, customs clearance for personal goods is not allowed. for this reason, shipment to russia is impossible. iran : iran has been banned from shipping as the united states and the united nations have designated it as a sanctioned country. for this reason, shipment to iran is impossible. 12 i purchased two different purchases, can it be shipped in one package? all of our purchases is processed based on the purchase number. purchases with different purchase number cannot be combined. 13 who is responsible for customs clearance tax? the recipient of the product that has been shipped internationally is responsible for customs tax and any additional fees that may incur. yes24 cannot predict or notify customers of any possible customs fees, taxes or additional charges that may occur and will not be held responsible. customs procedures and fees are different for each respective country, and it is up to the customer to check details for their respective destination country's laws and regulations with regards to customs clearance issues. 14 if i can't receive my package, how it will go on? delivery can be unsuccessful as the reason for incorrect delivery information, recipient absence, refuse to pay for taxes or customs clearance, etc. in this case, the package will be discarded at the local country, not the return to the sender. if you can’t receive your package for this reason, re-shipment may impossible. each different event has a different policy of re-shipment. please make sure to check the policy and notification in advance for relevant events. 15 possible reasons for delays or returns in international delivery international shipments may be delayed or returned for reasons related to customs procedures, local delivery policies, or recipient information. please review the following common cases to avoid delivery issues. common reasons for delivery delays or failures: 1.unable to reach the recipient, resulting in delivery failure or customs clearance delays 2.delay in the recipient’s tax payment 3.delivery refusal due to mismatch between purchaser and recipient 4.incorrect address, contact information, or zip code 5.refusal to pay local warehouse storage fees 6.refusal to pay customs clearance fees (delivery-related fees) 7.failure to submit the required customs clearance authorization form 8.recipient’s absence or no response 9.recipient cannot be located at the provided address 10.package refusal by the recipient, leading to return or disposal 11.exceeding the recipient’s personal customs clearance limit after reviewing the above, please contact at global_yesticket@yes24.com for further assistance. 16 other information if imposed taxes or warehouse fees are not paid, products can be discarded at the local country. product could be discarded if the customer does not claim the product or is out of contact within 5 days of its arriving. there are [ 8 ] answers for your question [ verified member ]. number subject 1 what is 'verified member only’? this is a yes24 global ticket member-exclusive identity verification service (ekyc). only members who complete verification can purchase tickets for selected concerts and musicals. • channels: global pc/mobile • genres: concerts, musicals (selected shows during poc) • verification: select country → foreign passport → face recognition 2 where can i verify my identity? identity verification is available through 2 methods: 1. from show detail page: • click 'verified member only' button • scan qr code and proceed with verification 2. from my info page: • go to my info > verify account section • click 'pre-verification' button • complete verification (same process as show page) • status changes to 'verified' after completion once verified through either method, you can book all 'verified member only' shows. 3 when should i complete identity verification? identity verification is mandatory for performances marked as 'verified member only'. important: • attempting verification right before ticket sales may cause delays due to high traffic • complete verification at least 1-2 days in advance • once verified, you can book all 'verified member only' shows without additional verification 4 how do i verify my identity? 1. click 'verified member only' button on show detail page 2. scan qr code with mobile phone 3. accept privacy policy and kyc terms 4. enter verification code from email, select nationality, photograph passport 5. review and edit passport information 6. take face photo 7. refresh show page after completion 8. check button change: • for on-sale shows: 'booking' button activated • for pre-sale shows: 'verified member' button displayed (automatically changes to 'booking' at sale time) 5 what documents are accepted? accepted: foreign passports only not accepted: • korean passports • national id cards (any country) • driver's licenses • passport copies or photos only physical foreign passports accepted. korean passport holders should use yes24 ticket (korean site). 6 what if status is 'declined' or 'pending’? if your verification status displays "declined"" or "pending,"the verification was not successfully completed or requires administrator review. contact customer support: - email: global_yesticket@yes24.com note: you cannot retry verification directly in this status. our administrator will review the cause and take necessary action. 7 can i change information after verification? this service prevents fraudulent reservations. cannot be modified after verification: • name • date of birth • email • nationality • gender reservations only possible with verified information. 8 can i verify with another account after withdrawal? if you delete your account, all verified information is erased, allowing verification with a different account. note: - accounts with violations cannot be deleted - manage your account carefully to avoid service disruptions - cannot recover previous account after withdrawal 9 can i cancel identity verification on my current id and transfer it to another id? if you wish to transfer your identity verification to a new id, please contact global_yesticket@yes24.com with the subject [inquiry on identity verification] before withdrawing your current account. please note that if you withdraw your account without prior inquiry, you will be restricted from re-joining or authenticating for 30 days. 10 i am a korean national residing overseas. how can i complete my identity verification? korean nationals residing abroad can complete the verification process by receiving a dedicated authentication url after confirming their residency status through our customer center. please follow the steps below to ensure a seamless reservation experience. 1. please submit a valid identification document from your country of residence (e.g., local id card, residence permit, or alien registration card) to our customer center. 2. once your documents are verified, a dedicated authentication url will be sent to your registered email address. 3. access the link and complete the verification using your korean passport within 3 days of receiving the url. important notices • you must use the exact same email address registered with your yes24 ticket global account for the verification to be valid and to enable ticket reservations. • please note that any authentication completed without prior consultation with our customer center will not result in an update to your member information. if you would like more detailed information in addition to faq customer center-mail (global_yesticket@yes24.com) to your name, contact information, e-mail address, along with purchase number, please send contact information. within 2 to 3 working days can answer that. terms and conditions privacy policy faq ceo: sukhwan paul kim / choi, se ra., 5th~6th floor11, eunhaeng-ro, yeongdeungpo-gu, seoul, 07237, south korea 이메일 : yes24help@yes24.com registration no: 229-81-37000, mail-order business no: 19-2682. yes24help@yes24.com hosting by yes24 copyright © yes24 corp. all rights reserved.

https://shop.weverse.io/en/notices/14202.text: weverse shop's new feature: auto payment for official membership (september 3, 2026) weverse shop weverse shop's new feature: auto payment for official membership (september 3, 2026) hello from weverse shop. starting september 3, 2026, at 4:00 pm (kst), the new “auto payment” feature will be available for official membership (hereinafter “membership”). auto payment is a feature that lets you automatically renew your membership using your registered payment method, without going through a separate purchase process, once you register an auto payment method on the weverse app or website. you can select auto payment when purchasing a membership product. if you are already using a membership, you can schedule auto payment from the “manage auto payment” menu. please refer to the instructions below on how to use auto payment. 1. how to schedule auto payment 1-(1). when purchasing a new membership when purchasing a membership, select auto payment under “payment method” at checkout, then register your auto payment method below to complete the payment. on the last day of the purchased membership’s validity period, the renewal auto payment will be processed using the primary payment method registered at the time of payment. 1-(2). when already using a membership even if you are already using a membership, you can select [schedule auto payment] on the order details page for that membership, then register a payment method and schedule auto payment on the “schedule auto payment” page. *for detailed instructions on registering an auto payment method, please refer to “ 2. how to manage auto payment ” below. starting september 10, you can also schedule auto payment from [manage payment] at the bottom of your online membership card screen. selecting [change to auto payment] under “manage payment” will take you to the schedule auto payment page. *the [change to auto payment] button is only displayed for memberships that support auto payment. 2. how to manage auto payment (payment method and schedule details) you can manage all your auto payment methods and details from [manage auto payment] under ☰ at the top right of weverse shop (menu on the app, my on the web). 2-(1). manage auto payments set whether to use weverse shop cash first and add the payment method to use for auto payment for each membership category (global/japan/usa). selecting [+ add payment method] lets you set your preferred payment currency and add payment methods. if you set one of your payment methods as your primary payment method, auto payment will be processed using that payment method. * if you enable "use weverse shop cash first", your available weverse shop cash will be used first for auto payment, and auto payment will only be processed for the remaining balance. * you can add up to five auto payment methods per membership category (global/japan/usa), and set one primary payment method for each. * when making a payment, the payment currency you use to purchase the membership must match the payment currency of your primary auto payment method. 2-(2). manage auto payment details you can check and manage the scheduled payment date and payment status of memberships with auto payment scheduled. pay now: if you have auto payment scheduled but want to renew your membership right away (available only during the renewal period), you can select [pay now] to renew immediately. the 'pay now' button will be displayed only during the renewal period. retry now: if auto payment does not go through successfully due to an issue with your payment method, you can select [retry now] to try again. cancel payment: selecting [cancel payment] lets you cancel auto payment. *even if you cancel auto payment, you can continue using your current membership normally until its validity period ends. canceling auto payment does not cancel or refund the payment you already made for your current membership. for more information on membership cancellation and refund, please check each membership's product detail page or the weverse help faq page. reactivate: if you canceled auto payment but want to use it again, you can select [reactivate] to undo the cancellation and reschedule auto payment. *you cannot reactivate your previous auto payment once the renewal period has ended. in such cases, please purchase the membership once again to set up auto payment. starting september 10, 2026, you can also check the scheduled renewal payment date from [manage payment] at the bottom of the relevant online membership card screen. 3. please note the supported payment method may vary by membership product. you can check the detailed payment method at checkout. auto payment takes place on the last day of your current membership’s validity period, at the same time you first paid for the membership. if you renew your membership via auto payment, the member information registered on your
